required_outputs: exact IDs from immutable BH-03 entry ledger
review_independence: One implementing agent; analytical lenses are not independent reviewers.

decisions.accepted: All active requirements evidenced and no open blocking finding; BH-04 eligible, not authorized.
decisions.revise: Reproducible in-scope gap; BH-04 ineligible pending corrective implementation and a superseding review.
decisions.blocked: Required active evidence unavailable or invalid; BH-04 ineligible.

rules: Hash-bind all seven completion decisions and current implementation/test evidence.
Reconcile every inherited condition, finding, acceptance ID, and deferral explicitly.
Run inherited validators, research tests/generators, JavaScript, pinned Mix/runtime checks, active Chrome/Firefox scenarios and measurements.
Retain corrective findings rather than changing requirements to obtain acceptance.
Do not count an unavailable platform, coarse memory observation, or injected transport as production qualification.
